name: Happy Teddy
source:
Main heroine loses her grandmother, so she is adopted by distant relatives. During her stay with grandmother there was a boy who treated her well and even gave teddy bear as a present while keeping the twin bear. Twelve years later protagonist returns back to home town in hope to find that teddy bear boy.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角失去了祖母，被远房亲戚收养。在她和祖母住在一起的时候，有个男孩对她很好，甚至还送了泰迪熊作为礼物，同时留下了双胞胎小熊。十二年后，主角回到家乡，希望找到那个泰迪熊男孩。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
